about_the_game:
Blightspire is a fast-paced wave-based survival shooter inspired by old-school shooters with a modern twist.

The inhabitants of Gravina have transformed into monsters in a strange outbreak of the bubonic plague and sought refuge in the cathedral.

It didn't save them.

Survive wave after wave of the unrelenting onslaught of the Black Death as the infected swarm you.

  • You have to avoid getting infected by the mutated monsters by using your thief's agility to

    dash and jump around them.

  • Use the arsenal provided by the authorities to dispose of those that get to close and eradicate the once human monstrosities.

  • The holy shotgun will help you stay in the fight by draining life from the unholy.

Each hit and kill increases your score, as you keep hitting enemies consecutively your hit counter increases which boosts the gains even more. Survive as long as possible while keeping your hit counter up to get the highest score and compete with your friends.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains assets depicting hanging corpses.
